gate_evaluation.outcome: Both conditions fail independently. Either alone mandates the stop; the coverage falsifier is the pre-registered one, the selection bias is the one that would still have blocked a grade had coverage cleared 0.60.

selection_bias_against_the_goal_s_own_ta.why_this_matters: Phase 2 exists to grade SILENT (non-consumed) recalls. On alt the join recovers 2039 silent events = 12.66% of the store, and selects them by a mechanism correlated with the very outcome variable phase 4 would model. A grade over that sample could not support the phase-4 generalization claim even if the coverage falsifier were ignored.
selection_bias_against_the_goal_s_own_ta.mechanism: The dominant tier (event_id_echo, 4257 of 4426 matches = 96.2%) finds an event precisely because its recall_event_id was written into the transcript, and the main reason an id gets written there is the memory_remember provenance that CONSUMES it. That tier is therefore close to a consumption detector rather than a neutral join.

replication_of_the_local_finding.conclusion: The bias is not a property of one host's corpus. It replicates on an independent store, at the same magnitude, through the same tier.

alt_is_worse_than_local_in_one_specific_.finding: On local the transport_session tier was a genuine control: consumed share 0.182 against a store base rate of 0.172, i.e. no enrichment. On alt that tier is itself enriched — 0.414201 against a base rate of 0.151348, a 2.74x factor on n=169.
alt_is_worse_than_local_in_one_specific_.implication: The alt field offers no neutral join tier at all, so there is no unbiased sub-sample to fall back to, however small.
alt_is_worse_than_local_in_one_specific_.caveat: n=169 is small and this comparison was not pre-registered; it is recorded as an observation that weakens the fallback, not as a measured refutation of the tier.

recency_confound_ruled_out.test: consumed share compared between matched and unmatched events within each calendar month
recency_confound_ruled_out.conclusion: The enrichment holds inside every comparable month, so it is not an artifact of which transcripts survived.
recency_confound_ruled_out.source: coverage-alt.json selection_bias.within_month_control, produced by the phase-1 alt node

supporting_evidence.note: Measured while evaluating the gate, on the same read-only alt store. NOT pre-registered; recorded because it bears on whether the goal should be re-scoped rather than merely retried.

structural_ceiling.implication: The join is already at its ceiling — it recovers 4426 events against a ceiling of 4403 echoing events (the 169 transport_session matches supply the small excess). Even a flawless join could not exceed ~27.4% here, so the 60% falsifier is unreachable on this corpus too. Not a runner defect, not tunable.
structural_ceiling.and_this_is_not_a_retention_effect: Unlike local, the alt corpus has full retention: missing_transcripts = 0, the corpus window covers 16098 of the store's 16102 events, and all 2983 index rows verified byte-identical. Retention modulates the ceiling (12.6% local vs 27.4% alt) but does not cause the failure; the binding constraint is the echo mechanism itself.

the_prescribed_method_cannot_reach_the_u.finding: delivery_record_index — the anchor the grading method requires, because grading must start strictly AFTER the delivery instant to avoid the LM tool-result echo trap — is present on exactly the 4257 event_id_echo rows and NULL on all 169 transport_session rows.
the_prescribed_method_cannot_reach_the_u.implication: Every event the prescribed method could grade comes from the consumption-detector tier, and every event from the non-detector tier is ungradeable by that method for want of a delivery instant. The bias is not merely large on this field; it is structurally inseparable from the method, so it could not be mitigated by restricting the grade to the clean tier.
the_prescribed_method_cannot_reach_the_u.trap_reference: LM trace 01M156TEX2DMMA8HNNZF52H7B2 — the transcript contains the delivered payload itself at the delivery moment, so grading that does not start strictly after delivery_record_index scores ~1.0 for every event.

Producing a verdict distribution, a calibrated threshold and a noise floor over a sample the gate has already declared too poor — and that the bias measurement has declared unrepresentative — would manufacture numbers the goal committed in advance not to trust.
